title: Battle of 4 May
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of 4 May", at revision 1375628137, opens: "The Battle of 4 May was fought in open sea near Salvador, Bahia, on 4 May 1823, between the Imperial Brazilian Navy, under the command of British admiral Thomas Cochrane, and the Portuguese Navy during the Brazilian War of Independence." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2890728, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1823 naval battle during the Brazilian War of Independence". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
